title: 供应商发货成本高，怎样提议合并配送？
topic: 用合并货运、透明定价和分阶段参与改善供应链效率

source.title: Walmart Enhances Supply Chain to Bring Customers What They Need, When They Need It
source.section: Walmart Enhances Supply Chain to Bring Customers What They Need, When They Need It
source.type: 沃尔玛官方供应链方案公告
source.context: Walmart 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: BENTONVILLE, Ark., May 26, 2026 — Continuing its commitment of Everyday Low Prices (EDLP) for customers, Walmart today announced a new supply chain strategy, Prepaid Consolidation. This program helps get products to shelves and customers faster by simplifying inbound supplier logistics and building a more connected, scalable, tech-enabled supply chain that improves service and lowers costs.

The program expands Walmart’s first mile capabilities for prepaid suppliers by using its national supply chain network to create a scalable way to merge shipments, creating greater transportation efficiency. Suppliers send products under a single national purchase order to one location, and from there Walmart combines the inventory and distributes it across its 42 regional distribution centers (RDCs).

The Prepaid Consolidation Program is built to make things easier for suppliers while still giving them flexibility. Since it’s managed by Walmart, there’s no need for suppliers to change their prepaid freight terms. Instead, they can choose to manage their shipments directly through Walmart or work with company-approved third-party logistics providers (3PLs), including C.H. Robinson, Hub Group, and RJW Logistics.

Through the process, suppliers pay a transparent, price-per-case rate, covering case handling at the automated consolidation center (ACC) and outbound transportation to Walmart RDCs. Suppliers working with participating providers will access region-specific pricing through Walmart’s published rate card, with no additional markups applied by participating providers to services performed by Walmart.

Suppliers benefit from simplified shipping — one National PO, one destination — along with transparent pricing and access to Walmart’s national distribution network. The model improves efficiency without requiring changes to prepaid freight terms, and it can reduce total cost while improving speed to shelf.

By consolidating inbound shipments and allocating inventory across its RDCs, Walmart improves flow consistency and reduces variability. This enhances replenishment precision and supports stronger in-stock performance across stores.

The Prepaid Consolidation Program will scale in phases, and participation will be prioritized based on volume alignment and capacity expansion. Suppliers interested in participating should contact WTS_Consolidation@Walmart.com or one of the participating providers to explore eligibility.
translations: 在继续兑现为顾客提供天天低价（Everyday Low Prices，EDLP）的承诺之际，沃尔玛于今日宣布新的供应链策略“预付运费合并配送”。该项目通过简化供应商入库物流、建设更加互联、可扩展并由技术支持的供应链，让商品更快上架并送达顾客，同时改善服务、降低成本。
该项目利用沃尔玛全国供应链网络，为预付运费的供应商扩展首程运输能力，建立一种可扩展的货运合并方式，提高运输效率。供应商按一张全国采购订单把商品送到一个地点，之后沃尔玛集中库存，并配送至 42 个区域配送中心。
预付运费合并配送项目旨在让供应商更方便，同时保留灵活性。由于项目由沃尔玛管理，供应商无需更改预付运费条款；他们可以直接通过沃尔玛管理货运，也可以选择经沃尔玛批准的第三方物流服务商，包括 C.H. Robinson、Hub Group 和 RJW Logistics。
在此流程中，供应商按每箱支付透明的价格，涵盖自动化合并中心的箱件处理以及运往沃尔玛区域配送中心的出库运输。与合作服务商共同操作的供应商，可以根据沃尔玛公布的价目表获取各区域的价格；服务商不会对沃尔玛执行的服务额外加价。
供应商受益于简化后的运输方式——一张全国采购订单、一个目的地——以及透明定价和使用沃尔玛全国配送网络的机会。这种模式无需更改预付运费条款，也能提升效率、降低总成本并加快商品上架。
沃尔玛通过合并入库货运并在各区域配送中心之间分配库存，改善货物流转的一致性、减少波动。这能提升补货精准度，并帮助各门店保持更稳定的有货率。
预付运费合并配送项目将分阶段扩大，并根据货量匹配情况和运力扩充情况优先安排参与资格。有意参与的供应商可联系 WTS_Consolidation@Walmart.com 或合作服务商，进一步了解资格要求。
fullTextParagraphs: BENTONVILLE, Ark., May 26, 2026 — Continuing its commitment of Everyday Low Prices (EDLP) for customers, Walmart today announced a new supply chain strategy, Prepaid Consolidation. This program helps get products to shelves and customers faster by simplifying inbound supplier logistics and building a more connected, scalable, tech-enabled supply chain that improves service and lowers costs.

The program expands Walmart’s first mile capabilities for prepaid suppliers by using its national supply chain network to create a scalable way to merge shipments, creating greater transportation efficiency. Suppliers send products under a single national purchase order to one location, and from there Walmart combines the inventory and distributes it across its 42 regional distribution centers (RDCs).

“We’re focused on making our supply chain simpler, faster and more efficient for suppliers, while also keeping products in stock for our customers,” said Mike Gray, senior vice president of Supply Chain at Walmart U.S. “By strengthening our first-mile capabilities, we’re reducing complexity and keeping goods moving, so we can deliver even more value every day.”

The Prepaid Consolidation Program is built to make things easier for suppliers while still giving them flexibility. Since it’s managed by Walmart, there’s no need for suppliers to change their prepaid freight terms. Instead, they can choose to manage their shipments directly through Walmart or work with company-approved third-party logistics providers (3PLs), including C.H. Robinson, Hub Group, and RJW Logistics.

Through the process, suppliers pay a transparent, price-per-case rate, covering case handling at the automated consolidation center (ACC) and outbound transportation to Walmart RDCs. Suppliers working with participating providers will access region-specific pricing through Walmart’s published rate card, with no additional markups applied by participating providers to services performed by Walmart.

Suppliers benefit from simplified shipping — one National PO, one destination — along with transparent pricing and access to Walmart’s national distribution network. The model improves efficiency without requiring changes to prepaid freight terms, and it can reduce total cost while improving speed to shelf.

By consolidating inbound shipments and allocating inventory across its RDCs, Walmart improves flow consistency and reduces variability. This enhances replenishment precision and supports stronger in-stock performance across stores.

The Prepaid Consolidation Program will scale in phases, and participation will be prioritized based on volume alignment and capacity expansion. Suppliers interested in participating should contact WTS_Consolidation@Walmart.com or one of the participating providers to explore eligibility.

Walmart Inc. (Nasdaq: WMT) is a people-led, tech-powered omnichannel retailer helping people save money and live better - anytime and anywhere - in stores, online, and through their mobile devices. Each week, approximately 280 million customers and members visit more than 10,900 stores and numerous eCommerce websites in 19 countries. With fiscal year 2026 revenue of $713 billion, Walmart employs approximately 2.1 million associates worldwide. Walmart continues to be a leader in sustainability, corporate philanthropy, and employment opportunity. Additional information about Walmart can be found by visiting corporate.walmart.com, on Facebook at facebook.com/walmart, on X (formerly known as Twitter) at twitter.com/walmart, and on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/company/walmart.

scenario.title: 供应链方案：合并小批发货，保留供应商选择
english: Several suppliers send small, partially loaded shipments to separate distribution centers.
They want lower freight costs but cannot change their current prepaid freight terms.
Propose one consolidation point, explain the available provider options, and suggest how to measure delivery speed and cost in a pilot.
chinese: 多家供应商把小批、未满载的货物分别送往不同配送中心。
他们希望降低运费，但不能更改当前预付运费条款。
请提出一个货运合并地点，说明可选服务商，并建议如何在试点中衡量交付速度和成本。

firstAttempt.prompt: 供应商发货批次多、运输成本高，但不希望更改现有运费条款。请用英文介绍合并配送方案、说明供应商的选择，并提出试点指标。
firstAttempt.sample: We can consolidate inbound shipments at one regional center and distribute the inventory across Walmart’s regional distribution centers. Suppliers can keep their current prepaid freight terms and choose Walmart or an approved logistics provider. The program uses a transparent price-per-case rate for handling and outbound transportation. For a pilot, we should compare cost per case, time to shelf, and in-stock performance with the current process. The program will scale in phases as capacity expands.
firstAttempt.rationale: 方案覆盖集中交货、条款不变、服务商选择和试点评估，不只说“能降低成本”。

words.example: We can consolidate inbound shipments at one center.
words.translation: 我们可以在一个中心合并入库货运。
words.note: 把多个较小批次集中处理或运输。

words.example: The provider offers a transparent price per case.
words.translation: 服务商提供透明的每箱计费价格。
words.note: 明确计费单位，有助于供应商估算整体费用。

words.example: The new replenishment plan improved in-stock performance.
words.translation: 新的补货计划改善了门店有货表现。
words.note: 关注顾客需要商品时，门店是否有货可买。

choice.prompt: 供应商愿意参加试点，但不能调整现有运费条款。哪种方案更容易被接受并检验效果？
options: Require every supplier to change its freight terms and join immediately.
Offer one consolidation destination, retain current terms, allow an approved provider option, and compare cost and delivery performance in a pilot.
Focus only on the number of suppliers who signed up.
choice.why: 第二条保留现有条款和服务商选择，并用成本与交付结果评估试点。

output.prompt: 你向供应商建议把四个小批次合并送到区域中心，再由团队配送到门店。请用英文说明供应商条款不变、服务商选择和试点衡量方式。
output.sample: We can consolidate the four small shipments at one regional center and distribute the inventory to stores from there. Your current prepaid freight terms can remain unchanged, and you can manage shipments through our team or an approved provider. During the pilot, we will compare cost per case, time to shelf, and in-stock performance with the current process.
